blockers.detail: dev_cv: the macenko-v1 reference was fitted once on train-split slides of the dataset and is shared by every outer fold, and every development patient is held out by exactly one fold, so each fold's held-out images shaped the normalisation of its own fitting data (preprocessing leakage; label-free, effect unknown)
